## Decisions

- Default to NAVER Maps GL Normal for Korean place-label readability.
- Offer Terrain and Hybrid as direct alternatives in the compact map overlay.
- Keep attribution visible and preserve map center, zoom, markers, and selection while switching styles.
- Use 12px or larger for controls and body text, with 11px reserved only for supporting copy.
- Prefer Korean-only local map labels over simultaneous romanized and Korean labels.
